purpose: Observe whether GitHub scheduled Defence control-plane workflows are arriving at the expected cadence, without treating scheduler activity as source proof or authority proof.

states.watch: At least one schedule is delayed beyond the warning age but not beyond the critical age.
states.warning: At least one schedule is missing, invalid-future or silent beyond the critical age.

invariants: Scheduled workflow activity is diagnostic metadata, never an evidence source for source availability or authority state.
The sentinel cannot create or refresh rollback source proof.
The sentinel cannot extend any proof TTL.
The sentinel cannot mint or refresh attestation authority state.
The sentinel cannot override estate, admission or rollback readiness state.
Push or workflow-dispatch success does not masquerade as scheduled liveness.
Browser roles receive no EXECUTE grant.
